description: Golden vectors for PolicyEngine.evaluate. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3. Each vector: evaluate input at `now` with device time zone `deviceTimeZone` (bundle.timeZone overrides it). `expect` lists EVERY known group (bundle groups + local groups) with blocked/strict/reason. Implementations in Swift (TetherCore) and TypeScript (server) must pass all vectors.

vectors.name: overnight window started previous day is active
overnight window ends exclusive next morning
overnight window for Monday is not active early Monday
vectors.note: days lists the day the window STARTS

vectors.name: start equals end is never active
guarded rule blocks like flexible
vectors.note: guarded = flexible for the engine; the guard is an app-side edit lock

vectors.name: usage limit hit yesterday does not block
usage limit day computed in local tz
vectors.note: 23:30 PST is already Tuesday in UTC; the day must be the local day

vectors.name: usage limit not on listed day
session reason earliest-ending when none strict
session + strict rule: reason session, strict from rule
pause with nothing to lift reports none
expired timed unblock: block restored offline
override issuedAt tie broken by larger id
local rules ignored when allowLocalRules is false
vectors.note: local groups still appear in output (unblocked); local sessions are still honored

vectors.name: local session honored even when allowLocalRules is false
rules referencing unknown groups are ignored
vectors.note: output contains only known groups; grp_unknown must not appear

vectors.name: device timeZone used when bundle has none
DST spring-forward window still evaluated by wall clock
tie among equal-priority block rules: strict first
tie among equal-priority block rules: smallest id
tie among equal-priority allow rules: smallest id
multiple pauses: latest-ending pause is the reason
